name: Ba**man. ~Rinkan to Ryoujoku~
source:
Miho Az*ki goes to an audition to fulfill her acting dream but becomes nervous. While waiting for her turn she panics about what a huge gig it might be... and without encouragement or confidence, her turn comes.

At the same time, in different locations, Miho, Kaya and Kou are each violated!

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE072460.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
阿兹基美穗为了实现演艺梦想而去参加试镜，但却变得紧张。在等待轮到她的时候，她担心这可能是一场多么巨大的演出……在没有鼓励或信心的情况下，轮到她了。

与此同时，在不同的地点，美穗、加夜和小浩分别受到侵犯！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE072460.html]DLsite English[/url]]
